summary: Synthetic example only. Five facets are covered, every finding has a verbatim quote from synthetic-source.md, and the reporting checklist separates missing from incorrect reporting.
question: Synthetic methods and statistics review.

findings.original_quote: Participants were allocated to two groups without randomization or blinding.
findings.fix: Report the allocation method and any blinding; if neither was used, state the resulting bias risk and add a sensitivity analysis.

evidence.quote: Participants were allocated to two groups without randomization or blinding.

findings.original_quote: The outcome was recorded as a binary variable, but analyzed as continuous.
findings.fix: Align the analysis with the binary outcome (e.g. logistic regression or a proportion test), or justify why a continuous analysis is valid.

evidence.quote: The outcome was recorded as a binary variable, but analyzed as continuous.

findings.original_quote: Independent-samples t tests were used for repeated measurements from the same sample.
findings.fix: Use a paired or mixed-effects analysis for repeated measurements, and state the independence assumption explicitly.

evidence.quote: Independent-samples t tests were used for repeated measurements from the same sample.

findings.original_quote: No sample size or power calculation was reported.
findings.fix: Report the pre-specified effect size, alpha, power and attrition assumptions, or label any post hoc power calculation as post hoc.

evidence.quote: No sample size or power calculation was reported.

findings.original_quote: The 95% confidence interval and exact p value were not reported.
findings.fix: Add the effect size, 95% confidence interval, exact p value, test statistic and degrees of freedom, and reconcile the n values between Methods and the table.

evidence.quote: The 95% confidence interval and exact p value were not reported.

checks.detail: Allocation without randomization or blinding is reported.
Independent-samples test used for repeated measurements.
No sample size or power calculation.
CI and exact p are missing; n values differ between sections.

decision_rules.condition: repeated measurements from the same sample
decision_rules.decision: use a paired or mixed-effects analysis, not an independent-samples test
use logistic/proportion analysis or justify a continuous approximation
mark as insufficient evidence; do not invent a power value

decision_rules.condition: effect estimate reported without CI or exact p
decision_rules.decision: record a reporting_gap and request effect size, CI, exact p and df

decision_rules.condition: n differs between Methods, Results and tables
decision_rules.decision: record an inconsistency and ask which denominator is correct

evidence.quote: Participants were allocated to two groups without randomization or blinding.
The outcome was recorded as a binary variable, but analyzed as continuous.
Independent-samples t tests were used for repeated measurements from the same sample.
No sample size or power calculation was reported.
The 95% confidence interval and exact p value were not reported.

uncertainties.reason: The synthetic example has no raw dataset.
uncertainties.impact: Statistical claims cannot be recomputed from data.
uncertainties.action: Request the raw data or analysis code from the authors.
